title: Five short lessons on working with a coding agent · Agent Kit
description: What an agent does, how to ask, what a prompt is, when a skill helps, and how to check a change. One action each, on the same small app.
ogTitle: Five short lessons on working with a coding agent · Agent Kit

title: What a coding agent does: lesson 1 · Agent Kit
description: A coding agent reads the files in your project folder, decides what to change, and changes them. It can also run commands, such as starting a preview. It works from what you type plus what it finds in the folder, so it only knows your project as well as those files describe it.
ogTitle: What a coding agent does: lesson 1 · Agent Kit

title: How to ask for a change: lesson 2 · Agent Kit
description: A good request says three things: what to change, what to leave alone, and how you’ll know it’s done. Agents fill gaps with guesses. A vague request like “make it better” invites a rewrite you didn’t want.
ogTitle: How to ask for a change: lesson 2 · Agent Kit
h1: How to ask for a change

title: What a prompt is: lesson 3 · Agent Kit
description: A prompt is any text you paste into an agent. The ones in Agent Kit’s library add what a quick request leaves out: what to look at, what evidence to bring back, and what not to touch. That way you can check the answer yourself instead of trusting that the agent looked.
ogTitle: What a prompt is: lesson 3 · Agent Kit

title: When a skill helps: lesson 4 · Agent Kit
description: A skill is a set of instructions the agent loads for one kind of job, written by someone who does that job well. You call it by name, like /design, and it brings checks and habits you’d otherwise have to type every time.
ogTitle: When a skill helps: lesson 4 · Agent Kit

title: How to check a change: lesson 5 · Agent Kit
description: An agent saying “done” isn’t proof. Before you commit, check three things: which files changed and how (GitHub Desktop shows each changed line), that the feature works in the browser, and that what worked before still works.
ogTitle: How to check a change: lesson 5 · Agent Kit
